observations: body L1-L22: the last two entries of the Conspectus, each hanging from its abbreviation at the margin; L14 begins a paragraph inside the first entry. «Ḥunayn ibn Isḥāq», «Thābit ibn Qurrah», «Assemani», «‘Alī ibn Riḍwān», «al-Hamdānī», «Platonem Tiburtinum», «Ahlwardt», «Ulugh Beg» and «Th. Hyde» are letter-spaced. The dot under the h of «Ḥunayn» and «Isḥāq» is printed as a small arc joined to the letter, as on pp. XI and XIV.
body L4-L5: «in–12o» (L4) has a long dash (5.6 pt) and a raised o; «ta‘līq» has a macron over the i (1.9 by 0.8 pt, like the macrons of «naskhī» and «rabī‘»; the dots of the i measure about 1.4 pt).

body L6-L13: the Arabic incipit of the codex and the beginning of book I, set right to left inside the Latin lines as printed: L6 ends with «كتاب الاربع مقالات في الاحكام», L7 and L10-L12 are Arabic only, L8 begins with the end of the incipit followed by its stop and the Latin, L9 begins with «f. 233,v.:» followed by the Arabic, and L13 holds the last words with their stop at the right, the line set from the indent. The Arabic commas are printed as turned commas; the elongated joins of «بـــه» (L11) and «لهـــا» (L12) are transcribed with tatweels. The lām-alif of «الاربع», «الاحكام», «الاولى», «الامور» and «الارض» is printed with its two strokes crossing, like an X.
body L15: a dot below the second e of «Heben» is a speck; the first e prints broken.
body L16, L19: «28–44» (4.8 pt) and «xx–xxiii» (5.5 pt) have long dashes; «xx» and «xxiii» are small capitals.

body L17-L18: the Greek title of book II, chapter 3 of the Tetrabiblos; the smooth breathing of «ἀστέρας» is printed as a slanting stroke like an acute accent, as in this Greek type elsewhere (p. XIV).
body L21: the sign = is printed long (10 pt).
body: a closing rule ends the Conspectus: 89.0 pt long and 0.6 pt thick, centred, 135 pt below the last line.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
